name: Wesco Electrical Supply
old_description: Since 1922 Wesco has been the leading electrical products and solutions provider. Electrification has and will continue to change the world with digitalization, green energy and grid modernization only accelerating change.
about:
Wesco Electrical Supply was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Bangor, Maine. The company began as an electrical products provider and has grown into a global distributor of electrical, communications, and utility supplies. It operates as a publicly traded corporation, ranked on the Fortune 500, with no single family or veteran ownership indicated in public records.

Today Wesco distributes more than 1.5 million products across over 50 countries, serving 150,000 customers with a workforce of approximately 20,000 employees. Its service portfolio includes project coordination and forecasting, grid hardening solutions, program management, regular hardware inspections, ground assembly rotation, and security hardware supply. The company emphasizes supply chain services and continuous improvement culture to manage complex customer requirements.

Wesco’s customer base spans communications and networking, power generation and distribution, electrical and lighting, and security sectors. It also supports emerging markets such as battery energy storage systems and AI-driven edge computing infrastructure. Typical buyers include utilities, contractors, industrial facilities, and commercial construction firms.

The company cites its broad product availability, global logistics network, and dual ISO 9001:2015 and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications as key differentiators. Recognition such as Fortune’s World’s Most Admired Companies listing, AIQ 75 ranking, and Great Place to Work certification reflect its stated focus on operational excellence and employee engagement.
